exposure: thyroid disorders (subclinical hypothyroidism, hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, subclinical hyperthyroidism)
outcome: abnormal uterine bleeding (AUB) patterns (heavy menstrual bleeding, irregular cycles, prolonged bleeding, light bleeding, frequent cycles, infrequent cycles)
cohort: The study included 400 women of reproductive age (18-45 years) presenting with various menstrual disorders.
finding: 105 out of 400 participants had a thyroid abnormality, with heavy and prolonged bleeding frequently associated with hypothyroidism and subclinical hypothyroidism, and light and short bleeding with hyperthyroidism.
